name: Trisara Phuket
tagline: All-pool-villa luxury on a private northwest coast bay
taglineZh: 普吉西北海岸私密海湾的全泳池别墅奢华度假村
description: Trisara is Phuket's most exclusive all-villa resort, tucked into a private bay on the island's quiet northwest coast. Every villa has its own infinity pool, and the resort is famed for Michelin-listed restaurant PRU and flawless private service.
descriptionZh: Trisara 是普吉最顶级的全别墅度假村，隐匿于岛上安静的西北海岸私密海湾。每栋别墅均配私人无边泳池，米其林入选餐厅 PRU 与无微不至的私人服务闻名遐迩。

name: Amari Phuket
tagline: Beachfront resort next to Patong, yet blissfully private
taglineZh: 紧邻巴东却独享私密的海滨度假酒店
description: Amari Phuket occupies its own headland between Patong Beach and the quieter south, offering spacious rooms, hillside villas and a private beach club. Guests enjoy easy access to Patong nightlife while returning to a tranquil resort setting.
descriptionZh: Amari Phuket 坐落于巴东海滩旁的独立海岬，拥有宽敞客房、山坡别墅与私人海滩俱乐部。步行即可感受巴东夜生活，回到酒店又能尽享静谧。

name: The Nai Harn
tagline: Relaxed beachfront elegance by Nai Harn Beach
taglineZh: 奈涵海滩旁的轻松海滨雅居
description: The Nai Harn is a refined beachfront hotel directly on one of Phuket's most beautiful beaches in the island's south. Low-rise architecture, a large lagoon-style pool and several restaurants make it ideal for a quieter, family-friendly stay.
descriptionZh: The Nai Harn 直接坐落于普吉岛南部最美海滩之一，低层建筑、大型礁湖泳池与多家餐厅，是追求安静亲子度假的理想之选。
